home.hero_subtitle: Direct market access, AI-driven price prediction, industrial buyer matching, and government schemes connecting agricultural producers with clean energy and circular manufacturing industries.
home.intro_title: Transforming Agricultural Residue Into Sustainable Value
home.intro_desc: AgriConnect AI bridges the gap between agricultural producers and bio-based industrial buyers, eliminating distress sales and stubble burning while providing verified high-calorific feedstock for green manufacturing.
home.features_subtitle: Built with cutting-edge artificial intelligence, escrow security, and circular logistics.
home.feat1_desc: Powered by XGBoost machine learning trained on multi-regional commodity data to guarantee fair market pricing based on lab-tested moisture and quality.
home.feat2_desc: Direct connectivity with 2G bioethanol refineries, compressed biogas (CBG) power plants, paper pulp mills, and biomass pellet producers.
home.feat3_desc: 100% fraud-free transactions with buyer payment locked in escrow and released directly to farmers upon verified physical gate delivery.
home.feat4_desc: Instant discovery of MNRE subsidies, Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM/CRM), and SATAT biomass off-take initiatives.
home.feat5_desc: Agronomic analysis matching each crop residue with optimal conversion pathways: briquetting, furfural extraction, molded tableware, or biochar.
home.feat6_desc: Automated carbon emission reduction tracking (~1.35 MT CO2 diverted per ton of residue) for corporate Scope 3 sustainability compliance.
home.benefits_title: Value Creation Across the Agricultural Ecosystem
home.farmer_b1: Prevent distress sales with transparent AI price benchmarks
home.farmer_b2: Direct access to large industrial buyers without middlemen
home.farmer_b3: Guaranteed bank payouts protected by platform escrow
home.farmer_b4: One-click access to government machinery & baler subsidies
home.buyer_b2: Lab-certified moisture content and organic matter specifications
home.buyer_b3: Logistics cost estimation and proximity-based sourcing
home.buyer_b4: Downloadable verified ESG and carbon offset documentation
home.about_desc: AgriConnect AI was engineered to address India's dual challenge of post-harvest crop residue burning and industrial clean energy demand. By combining machine learning price intelligence with direct digital exchange, we provide farmers with dignified earnings while fueling India's green industrial transition.
home.contact_title: Get in Touch With Our Agricultural Network
home.contact_subtitle: Have questions about industrial procurement, farmer cooperative onboarding, or government scheme integration? Our agronomy and technical team is here to assist.
home.footer_rights: All rights reserved. Dedicated to farmer prosperity and clean air.

schemes_modal.subtitle: Direct financial assistance, equipment subsidies, and commercial biomass off-take initiatives.
schemes_modal.scheme1_body: Provides 50% to 80% capital subsidies for procurement of Super SMS, Happy Seeders, Straw Balers, and Paddy Straw Choppers. Applications open via State Agriculture Portals.
schemes_modal.scheme2_name: National Bioenergy Programme (Ministry of New & Renewable Energy)
schemes_modal.scheme2_body: Direct central financial assistance of ₹9,00,000 per MT/hr manufacturing capacity for non-torrefied pellet/briquette plants, and ₹15,00,000 for torrefied pellet units.
schemes_modal.scheme3_name: SATAT Initiative (Sustainable Alternative Towards Affordable Transportation)
schemes_modal.scheme3_body: Provides 10-year guaranteed commercial off-take agreements from PSU Oil Marketing Companies (IOCL, BPCL, HPCL) for CBG gas produced from agricultural residue at ₹46/kg + GST.
schemes_modal.scheme4_body: Financial support to Integrated 2G Bioethanol projects using lignocellulosic biomass and other agricultural residues.
